The '''Darlonn sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Seely]] met [[Drek Drednar]] here before becoming his lieutenant. The sector also had a mobile [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]].
